projects.name: Data Model
details: • Drove end-to-end platform ownership across enterprise-scale retail data platform architecture,
delivery, and lifecycle governance while leading a cross-functional team of 7 data engineers across
solution design, code reviews, and release planning.
• Defined enterprise data strategy and architected scalable dimensional data models and lakehouse
architecture for multi-billion-record sales datasets, enabling governed, high-performance analytics
across multiple retail business domains.
• Designed ingestion and transformation frameworks for ServiceNow operational data, improving incident
analytics and operational visibility.
• Strengthened data reliability by integrating Monte Carlo-based observability and anomaly detection,
reducing production data incidents by 40% and improving SLA adherence.
• Spearheaded AI-assisted engineering initiatives using Windsurf and GitHub Copilot to accelerate software
delivery, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity.
• Architected and developed a scalable Databricks-based chargeback dispute analytics platform that
consolidated multi-source transaction data and automated evidence generation for Stripe and American
Express disputes, improving dispute win rates by 35% and protecting $2M in revenue.
